title: Hinomori Shizuku — Energetic On Location!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Airi
rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
We can check off the meeting for that radio program now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The producer seemed like such a nice person too. They did a wonderful job of explaining everything and answered our questions thoroughly.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, we have a much better idea of what they want us to do and how we need to prepare for it now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Speaking of which, do you have notes ready for Haruka and Minori?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, they're ready. I'm glad we split the work by having you talk and me jotting everything down.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, but I would like you to take a look at them later to make sure I didn't miss anything.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sure thing... Hmm... Next, we're supposed to have a meeting at a cafe with the people from that magazine...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're probably gonna get there pretty early now, but we could look those over while we wait...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Is something the matter, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
No, um... It's just...
That Japanese confectionary shop caught my eye...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's see... “Adorable animal confections now on sale”...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, wow! Airi, look...!
They have cats, dogs, rabbits and all these other little animals! How cute!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, I can see that. I see them, but...
We still have work to do. We don't really have time for this right now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
So, we're not going...
That's just that.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (She looks so eager to go...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Um, Airi? Didn't you just say that we'd have a lot of time on our hands if we went over to the cafe now?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, yes...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And wouldn't it be better to look over my notes now as opposed to after we got to the cafe?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: T-True...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: See? So, why don't we stop by this shop? They even seem to have a seated porch area that looks very nice.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Grr... I was trying to resist that temptation...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks, Shizuku. Then, let's look through your notes over some Japanese sweets.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Great!

rows.Speaker: Waiter
rows.Line:
Thank you for your patience.
Here is your matcha and sweets set.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Airi, the kitten manju you got looks so cute.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know, right? After I saw those little round eyes looking at me, I couldn't not order it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But it needs to be eaten...
Oh no, I'm becoming more attached to it by the second.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. You did spend quite a long time deciding which one to get.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah...
But the rabbit daifuku you got's also really cute, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I particularly like how the mochi really makes it look like a fluffy rabbit. The red eyes are also a wonderful touch.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Aren't you gonna eat yours, Shizuku...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I could ask you the same thing, Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Then, we've just gotta do it...!
Hiya!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh no...! Your cat's face! It's been split in half...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Nom...
Mmm... Sho good!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then, I'll... I'm so sorry, Mr. Rabbit... Forgive me...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Mmm...!
This rabbit's so delicious!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Don't say that! Say you're eating a daifuku! Imagine if someone heard you saying that out of context!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, you're right.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Still, I didn't realize you could turn Japanese sweets into such cute animals...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, and a huge variety of them too. What else was there...? Bears, chickens and...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Pandas...and penguins.
Hehe. I'm sure Haruka would've chosen that one if she were here.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Definitely! Oh, what about Minori? A dog?
But it was a Shiba... Would she not choose it since it's not a Samoyed?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hmm... I wish she could've been here with us. Then we would know.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But she probably has class right about now...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's a little lonely without the others...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Um, Airi...?
How would you feel about us buying some souvenirs for them?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The next time we see them, we can give them some sweets along with our notes.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We could say that you spotted this Japanese confectionary shop when we were on our way to a meeting...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And how we began wondering which animals they would've chosen if they were also there.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Telling them about not just work but also what we discovered and talked about would help include them and remedy this feeling of loneliness.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I agree. I'm sure they also feel a little guilty about not being able to work because of school...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Having some of these adorable sweets should help cheer them up.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Exactly!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, let's buy some that we think they'll really enjoy on our way back.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But first, we're taking a look at those notes you just took!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay♪
